name: Unlimited (Indefinite) Residence Permit via Investment

requirement_groups.name: 5 years holding the Investment Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having held the Investment Residence Permit for 5 years with the required documented turnover maintained throughout.

requirement_groups.name: 5 years of qualifying real property ownership

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of qualifying real property ownership in Georgia.

evidence_required.document: 5 years' documented turnover records or property ownership records

sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (matsne.gov.ge) -- Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15(k)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is Article 15(k), reachable via two OR-logic groups per the source: 5 years holding the Investment Residence Permit (Article 15(h)) with turnover maintained, OR 5 years of qualifying real property ownership on its own (a route not gated behind ge_short_term_property_permit's annual renewal in the source as described). prerequisites lists only ge_investment_residence_permit since that is the one route in this dataset that maps cleanly onto the first group; the property-ownership group's own qualifying threshold was not itemised separately from the general 'real property ownership' language in the source, so no property-route prerequisite is asserted for that group specifically.
